key_insight: OmniTransfer is a unified framework that transfers and leverages rich spatio-temporal information from videos—rather than relying on static reference images or fixed temporal priors—enabling more flexible and general video customization and generation.
problem_solved: Existing video customization methods under-utilize inherent spatio-temporal cues and depend on image-based references or task-specific temporal priors, limiting flexibility, temporal coherence, and generalization across diverse video tasks.
method: Extract multi-view spatio-temporal representations that jointly capture spatial appearance and temporal dynamics from input videos.
Use a single, modular transfer module to adapt and inject learned spatio-temporal features into target generation or editing models, avoiding task-specific priors.
Optimize with objectives that preserve spatial fidelity and temporal consistency so transferred content remains coherent across frames.
impact: OmniTransfer simplifies and strengthens video customization pipelines by providing a general-purpose way to reuse spatio-temporal knowledge, improving temporal coherence and enabling broader generalization for video generation, editing, and transfer tasks.
visual_elements: Architecture diagram showing multi-view spatio-temporal encoder → unified transfer module → target generator
Before/after frame sequence that highlights improved temporal coherence across several frames
Timeline or flow visualization illustrating learned temporal features and consistency loss
Icon set: video frames, 3D/multi-view camera, transfer arrows, and a coherence/clock symbol
paper_title: OmniTransfer: All-in-one Framework for Spatio-temporal Video Transfer
paper_authors: Pengze Zhang, Yanze Wu, Mengtian Li, Xu Bai, Songtao Zhao
